questions.question: As Jesus neared Jerusalem, what did He tell two disciples they would find tied in the village ahead?
When Jesus sent two disciples to get a colt, what did He tell them to say if anyone asked why?

answers.text: The Lord needs it and will return it shortly
The Teacher will pay you back for it tonight
The priests have sent us here to collect it

questions.question: As the crowd welcomed Jesus into Jerusalem, they blessed the coming kingdom of which father?
After Jesus looked around the temple courts in Jerusalem and it was already late, what did He do?

answers.text: Went out to Bethany with the Twelve
Stayed the night in the temple courts
Headed back to Jericho with the crowd
